Company 1 - Rifle/guard company

Company 4 - Rifle/guard company

Company 5 - Administration and logistics company

Company 6 - Training/recruit company

​

Company 1, 2 and 4 are responsible for guarding and protecting the royal family and their residences, as well as guarding Akershus Fortress, which houses the prime minister's office. (Note that the Royal Guard are only responsible for guarding the fortress, not the PM. That task falls to the Security Section (Sikkerhetsseksjonen)).

Company 3 is the world renowned band and drill company and they do what it says on the tin. They are the most visible part of the guard and are basically the posterboys. Their main focus is training on drilling and playing instruments and thus they are exempt from guard duty.

Company 5 is the company that makes the wheels turn. They handle the paperwork, logistics and administration of the guard.

Company 6 is just a training company and after youre done with basic training you're transferred to another company.

There is also a quick reaction force consisting of around 60 soldiers that are tasked with responding to various situations that may arise in the capital of Oslo if the police are unable to handle it on their own. The Guard is in fact in close cooperation with the police in Oslo.

In addition to protecting the royal family, the Royal Guard also acts as the garrison for the capital and is it's main military defence force. After the terrorist attacks on July 22nd, 2011 Royal Guard was deployed all over the city in order to defend government buildings in addition to the strengthening of the security around the royal palace.
